components.name: InlineEditor
components.description: Rich text with no fixed toolbar: select text and a format menu with a link field floats over it. Markdown shortcuts (#, -, >, **bold**) still work.

props.name: defaultContent
props.description: Initial document as HTML or ProseKit JSON. Read once on mount.

props.name: tone
props.description: `default` draws the field border; `ghost` edits in place with none.

components.name: EditorShell
components.description: What SSR renders in an editor's place: the same frame, toolbar row and height.

components.name: EditorContent
components.description: The element ProseKit mounts into. ProseMirror adds its own classes to it, so keep `className` steady: a new value makes React overwrite them.

components.name: FormatToolbar
components.description: Block type, history and text formats on the Standard Toolbar. `children` adds groups after them (insert buttons, list indent).

props.name: blockTypes
props.description: Which block types the Select offers. Defaults to all of them.

props.name: marks
props.description: Which text formats get a toggle. Defaults to all of them.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Pushed to the end of the bar, e.g. a view toggle.

components.name: InlineFormatMenu
components.description: Text formats and a link field that float over the selection. Clicks on the bar don't take focus, so the selection stays put.
